description: This file is a configuration and utility module for Axios HTTP client setup in a React application. It manages base URL resolution, token handling, request/response interceptors, and URL normalization, primarily facilitating API communication with backend services.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns the appropriate API base URL based on environment variables and context.

methods.name: getOpenApiDocsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to the OpenAPI documentation endpoint for the backend API.
